$comment: Release-cooldown exemptions for check-lockfile-freshness.mjs. Each entry: { name, version?, reason, expires }. Expired or reason-less entries FAIL the gate (fail-closed, same contract as pqc-allowlist.json). Add an entry only for urgent fixes (e.g. a security advisory release) and let it expire. The entry may name a version: when it does, ONLY that version is exempt, and any other version of the same package must clear the cooldown normally.

allowed.name: undici
allowed.reason: undici vulnerable to Denial of Service via unbounded memory in the EventSource parser — urgent security fix across the shared pin seam (4 sites), per the freshness gate exception contract

allowed.name: body-parser
allowed.reason: GHSA body-parser trailing-bytes DoS — express transitive; urgent security fix (release-cooldown exception)

allowed.name: electron
allowed.reason: Electron eMudhra intermediate-cert mitigation advisory — devDep toolchain; urgent security fix (release-cooldown exception)

allowed.name: puppeteer-core
allowed.reason: puppeteer-core advisory (≤25.12) via lighthouse — app devDep; urgent security fix (release-cooldown exception)

allowed.name: chromium-bidi
allowed.reason: chromium-bidi advisory via puppeteer-core — app devDep; urgent security fix (release-cooldown exception)

allowed.name: @puppeteer/browsers
allowed.reason: required by the puppeteer-core security fix (<=25.12 advisory) — rides the cooldown exception
